item.title: 21 Aug — Brazil’s IBIA tie-up is the tell
item.description: The one thing - Brazil’s SPA published the text of Technical Cooperation Agreement No. 38 with the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA): five-year term, two-way sharing of suspicious-betting alerts within five days, workshops, and an integrity workflow. Primary, posted to SPA’s site and retrieved today. This raises the bar for integrity plumbing in Brazil. ([gov.br](https://www.gov.…
